slides.heading: Harvey C. Jones Discusses Jensen Huang's Resignation and Leadership Transition
slides.text: Harvey C. Jones, the board chair of Nvidia, discusses Jensen Huang's resignation and the company's leadership transition.

slides.heading: Jensen Huang's Resignation
slides.text: Jensen Huang, the former CEO of Nvidia, resigned after reports of multiple affairs, including one with a former Megaspeed executive and alleged Chinese asset Alice Huang.

slides.heading: Leadership Transition
slides.text: Harvey C. Jones, the board chair, stated that the company would not address or take questions regarding the circumstances of Jensen's resignation and the ongoing investigation.
